ways.label: Mingha - Deception Route, east to west (Greyneys Shelter to Morrisons footbridge)

start.name: Greyneys Shelter
start.quote: the route starts near Greyneys Shelter on SH73

end.name: Morrisons footbridge
end.quote: come out at Morrisons footbridge on SH73, near Aickens corner

via.name: Bealey River
via.quote: If Bealey River is too high to ford, postpone the trip.

via.name: Mingha River
via.quote: crossing Mingha River where it bends west towards Temple Col

via.name: Ōtira River
via.quote: The footbridge across the Otira is just north of the confluence

evidence: From the eastern side, the route starts near Greyneys Shelter on SH73. It follows the Mingha River, crosses the Main Divide at Goat Pass, then follows the Deception River to come out at Morrisons footbridge on SH73, near Aickens corner.

access_points.name: Morrisons footbridge
access_points.quote: From the western side, the route starts at Morrisons footbridge on SH73, near Aickens corner.

doubts: The page describes the route in both directions (east to west, then west to east). Per the rule that walking a crossing the other way round is not another way, only east to west is a way; the western start is an access point. Start F4 (Mingha Track meets West Coast Road) is taken as Greyneys Shelter on SH73 by inference; the text does not name it. End F2 is the Morrison Footbridge by name. Leg times only (5 hr, 8-9 hr), so DOC's 2 - 3 days used; no distance given. Mingha River 'crossing as necessary' not itemised. Bealey River has no entry. Earlier reading made the reverse a W2.
